0.0: Hey, I should fill you in on something useful.\r\n#L0##bSure. I'm all ears.#l\n#k
0.1: You know about the #bSilent Crusade UI#k yet? You can use it to look up #rthe location of the monsters you need to hunt and receive special rewards#k.\r\n#L0##bHow do I access this UI?#l\n#k
0.2: You can check the Silent Crusade UI by using the #rhotkey#k. \r\nClick the #bSettings#k button at the bottom of the screen and click #bKey Bindings#k to find the Silent Crusade hotkey. \r\nThe Silent Crusade UI also acts as an alert function every time #ba monster is defeated or a new monster is added#k, so it's good to check it frequently.

yes.0: Check the Silent Crusade notifier frequently! It will let you know when Maple World needs you.
